svg.title: GO GYM - Membership Terms & Conditions
svg.desc: Membership, responsibility, discipline, belongings, access, AC timings, electricity, training, management rights, and closing notes.

g.text: 1. Membership
Non-transferable & non-refundable. Valid for 1 session per day.
Membership is valid for 30 days from the date of joining or renewal.
No extension will be provided for missed days.
2. Responsibility
Workout at your own risk. GO GYM is not liable for injuries or
misuse of equipment.
3. Discipline
Re-rack weights after use. No unnecessary chatting or group workouts.
4. Belongings
Members are responsible for their personal belongings.
5. Access
Only registered members are allowed. No outsiders.
6. AC Timings
7. Electricity
Switch on fans only where needed and switch them off after your workout.
8. Training
Members are not allowed to train other members.
9. Management Rights
GO GYM may revise timings, plans, holidays, and policies.
Damage to gym property will attract penalties.

svg.text: Respect the Gym • Respect Others • Stay Fit!
If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us anytime!
